events.title: AX Q1 Deep Dive: Growth Fueled by Verdant Acquisition, Margin Pressures Persist
events.body: Digital banking company Axos Financial (NYSE:AX) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 27% year on year to $392.2 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.90 per share was 10.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
